dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed type of admissible run records for natural parameters n, b, and q. Its supplied constructor D015 packages the dimensions, matrices, vectors, error parameters, algebraic relations, and proofs used by the proposition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem is universally quantified only over data packaged as an admissible run, so all conditions supplied to D015 act as hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifth field of a run, namely its real n by n matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A appears in the perturbed system (A + DeltaA)xHat = rhs and in the componentwise perturbation weight.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sixth field of a run, namely the real n by n matrix LHat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: LHat contributes to the entrywise weight through the absolute-value matrix product of LHat and UHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The seventh field of a run, namely the real n by n matrix UHat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: UHat contributes to the entrywise weight through the absolute-value matrix product of LHat and UHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The thirtieth field of a run, namely the real vector rhs.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the right-hand side of the exact perturbed system asserted in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The thirteenth field of a run, namely the real parameter uBar.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters the effective-error choice, the coefficient alpha, and the packaged smallness assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fourteenth field of a run, namely the real parameter uFma.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It controls the piecewise effective error parameter used in the coefficient alpha.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twelfth field of a run, namely the real parameter uLow.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes the terms 2 uLow + uLow^2 and the factor (1 + uLow)^2 in alpha.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifteenth field of a run, namely the real parameter uWork.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters alpha and the additional coefficient 2 gamma_n(uWork) + gamma_n(uWork)^2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twenty-eighth field of a run, namely the real vector xHat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the vector for which the conclusion asserts (A + DeltaA)xHat = rhs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real u and natural m, gamma_m(u) = (m u)/(1 - m u), with m coerced to a real number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines every gamma factor in alpha and the outer perturbation coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines alpha = 2 uLow + uLow^2 + max(theta, gamma_b(uWork)) (1 + uLow)^2, where theta = gamma_(q-1)(uEff) + gamma_(n-b+1)(uBar) + gamma_(q-1)(uEff) gamma_(n-b+1)(uBar), and uEff is defined by D018. The subtractions are natural-number subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Alpha is the first part of the scalar multiplying the entrywise weight in the final DeltaA bound; it also bounds the packaged factorization error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each i,j, it is |A_ij| + sum_k |LHat_ik| |UHat_kj|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the nonnegative entrywise weight multiplied by the scalar error coefficient in the DeltaA bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Standard matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i = sum over all j in Fin n of A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the first conclusion the exact vector equation (A + DeltaA)xHat = rhs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for an admissible run. It requires 0 < n, 0 < b, 0 < q, n = q b; matrices A, LHat, UHat with LHat lower triangular, UHat upper triangular, diagonal entries LHat_ii = 1 and UHat_ii != 0; nonnegative uLow, uBar, uFma, uWork with uBar <= uFma; the four smallness conditions (q-1)uEff < 1, (n-b+1)uBar < 1, b uWork < 1, and n uWork < 1; a matrix factorError satisfying LHat UHat = A + factorError and |factorError_ij| <= alpha (|A_ij| + sum_k |LHat_ik||UHat_kj|); vectors xHat, yHat, rhs and matrices deltaL, deltaU satisfying (LHat + deltaL)yHat = rhs, (UHat + deltaU)xHat = yHat, |deltaL_ij| <= gamma_n(uWork)|LHat_ij|, and |deltaU_ij| <= gamma_n(uWork)|UHat_ij|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These packaged requirements are all the hypotheses under which the existential backward-error conclusion is asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices L and U, it returns the entry (i,j) of their absolute-value product: sum_k |L_ik| |U_kj|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the second term of the entrywise weight in D013.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: For real v,u and naturals r,s, it returns gamma_r(v) + gamma_s(u) + gamma_r(v) gamma_s(u).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied with v = uEff, u = uBar, r = q-1, and s = n-b+1, it produces theta inside alpha.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines uEff piecewise: uEff = uWork if uFma < uWork; otherwise uEff = 0 if uFma <= uBar; otherwise uEff = uFma.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This selected value is used in gamma_(q-1)(uEff), theta, alpha, and one packaged smallness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 1 + 1 qualifies as a numeral of at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is numeral-elaboration evidence associated with the constant 2 and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: For real u and natural m, the proposition m u < 1, with m coerced to a real number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run assumptions use it to ensure positive denominators for all gamma quantities occurring in the bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: The matrix L is lower triangular: L_ij = 0 whenever i < j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains LHat in every admissible run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The matrix U is upper triangular: U_ij = 0 whenever j < i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains UHat in every admissible run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: Standard matrix multiplication: (AB)_ij = sum over all k in Fin n of A_ik B_kj.

binders: Natural numbers n, b, and q.

An admissible run indexed by n, b, and q, containing matrices A, LHat, UHat, factorError, deltaL, deltaU; vectors xHat, yHat, rhs; real parameters uLow, uBar, uFma, uWork; and the proofs listed in the hypotheses.
The conclusion existentially quantifies a real n by n matrix DeltaA.
The componentwise bound universally quantifies indices i,j in Fin n.
hypotheses: The packaged dimensions satisfy 0 < n, 0 < b, 0 < q, and n = q b.
LHat is lower triangular, UHat is upper triangular, LHat_ii = 1 for every i, and UHat_ii != 0 for every i.
The parameters uLow, uBar, uFma, and uWork are nonnegative, and uBar <= uFma.
Define uEff = uWork if uFma < uWork; otherwise uEff = 0 if uFma <= uBar; otherwise uEff = uFma. The packaged smallness assumptions are (q-1)uEff < 1, (n-b+1)uBar < 1, b uWork < 1, and n uWork < 1.
The packaged factorization error satisfies LHat UHat = A + factorError and, for every i,j, |factorError_ij| <= alpha (|A_ij| + sum_k |LHat_ik||UHat_kj|).
The packaged perturbed triangular solves satisfy (LHat + deltaL)yHat = rhs and (UHat + deltaU)xHat = yHat.
For every i,j, |deltaL_ij| <= gamma_n(uWork)|LHat_ij| and |deltaU_ij| <= gamma_n(uWork)|UHat_ij|.
conclusions: There exists a real n by n matrix DeltaA such that (A + DeltaA)xHat = rhs exactly.
For every i,j, |DeltaA_ij| <= beta (|A_ij| + sum_k |LHat_ik||UHat_kj|), where beta = alpha + 2 gamma_n(uWork) + gamma_n(uWork)^2.
mathematical_definitions: Fin n is the index set {0,...,n-1}; vectors are functions Fin n -> Real and matrices are functions Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.
Matrix-vector multiplication is (Mx)_i = sum_j M_ij x_j, and matrix multiplication is (MN)_ij = sum_k M_ik N_kj.
For a natural m and real u, gamma_m(u) = (m u)/(1 - m u), with m interpreted as a real number.
uEff = uWork if uFma < uWork; uEff = 0 if uFma >= uWork and uFma <= uBar; and uEff = uFma otherwise.
alpha = 2 uLow + uLow^2 + max(theta, gamma_b(uWork)) (1 + uLow)^2.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every admissible run with positive natural dimensions n,b,q satisfying n = q b and with the packaged triangular-factorization and perturbed-solve assumptions stated above, there is an entrywise perturbation DeltaA of A for which xHat is an exact solution of (A + DeltaA)xHat = rhs. Each entry obeys |DeltaA_ij| <= [alpha + 2 gamma_n(uWork) + gamma_n(uWork)^2] [|A_ij| + sum_k |LHat_ik||UHat_kj|], with gamma, uEff, theta, and alpha defined exactly above.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The universal quantification is over inhabitants of the admissible-run type. For parameter triples or data admitting no such run, there is no run instance to which the assertion applies.
Although n,b,q are syntactically arbitrary natural numbers, every run packages strict positivity and n = q b; in particular, the zero-dimensional case is excluded.
Natural subtraction is truncated at zero. The packaged positivity and relation n = q b imply q >= 1 and n >= b, so q-1 and n-b agree with ordinary nonnegative subtraction for admissible runs.
Lean's real division is total, but the four smallness assumptions ensure that every denominator 1-mu occurring in the displayed gamma quantities is strictly positive.
The estimate is componentwise and uses scalar absolute values. It does not state a matrix-norm or vector-norm bound.
DeltaA is required only to be a real n by n matrix. No triangular, symmetric, sparse, rank, sign, or other structural restriction is imposed, and uniqueness is not asserted.
The proposition does not supply a formula for DeltaA or claim that DeltaA is itself a computed floating-point quantity.
No invertibility assumption on A is stated directly, and no condition number or forward-error estimate is included.

The floating-point interpretation is represented only through the packaged algebraic relations, nonnegativity, smallness conditions, and componentwise error bounds; no additional arithmetic model is encoded in the target.
